releaseNotes.en: Improved App Store reliability, offline recovery, and network guidance. Added new Camera settings with shutter sounds and clearer capture feedback. File browsing is smoother, Gallery QoL fixes,Gallery information is less intrusive, Manager updates are easier to notice, and Home icons are now more visually balanced.
releaseNotes.zh: 提升应用商店的稳定性、离线恢复和网络提示；新增相机设置、快门音效及更清晰的拍摄反馈；文件浏览更加流畅，图库QOL提升一些，图库信息显示更简洁，管理器更新更醒目，主页图标也更加协调统一。
